web_context.competitor_activity: Micron (MU) NAND revenues +169% YoY to $5B in Q2 FY2026, rallying alongside SNDK on shared AI-driven demand tailwind; analysts see memory demand persisting through 2030. Western Digital (WDC) competes directly in enterprise SSD for hyperscale data centers. Samsung (dominant global NAND share) benefits from same 1TB smartphone baseline shift. SNDK holds ~13% global NAND share but is increasingly viewed as the highest-margin enterprise-focused play. A 'Great Storage Supercycle' framing is gaining traction across all NAND names. (Sources: CNBC, Motley Fool, FinancialContent)
